scope: Only an isolated pure planner module and its standalone test registration. No production, format, recording, replay, or strict admission integration.

parameters.REPO: Exact frozen source checkout; existing fixed build-graph dependencies available
parameters.OUTPUT: Fresh local output directory outside source

preconditions: Exact target tree and clean tracked/untracked source verified before and after execution.
Independent static review complete; two recursive test generator error sets made explicit before freeze.
Source and this plan must be independently stored and read back from Git before execution.
Original long rejected tape and all historical results remain unchanged; this test does not read or modify them.

bounds.planner_allocation: none; state independent of read count
bounds.termination: Guard terminates process group; after 10 seconds kills it if necessary. Record actual terminal and remaining-process evidence, never infer cleanup from exit code alone.

oracles: All seven inline tests must execute and pass; compilation failure or skip is not a passing test.
Independent DFS enumerates all words and distinct global endpoint shuffles for one slot with each role length at most three, and two slots with each role length at most two.
Oracle uses separate state transition code and checks returned greedy source order, predicates, state/job identity, and bracket embedding; no calls to greedy enabled/apply/selection helpers.
Normal stderr must include ORACLE cases=4551834 feasible_prefix=<actual> complete=<actual>; record both actual subset counts.

Special tests cover both predicates/booleans/bracket orders, nonflipping stores, cross-slot global marker constraints, initially-free/finally-free lifecycle, reused IDs, malformed operations, overflow, and 65537 fixed-space reads.
contract_limits: Supports only 1..48 configured job slots and explicitly rejects 0 or larger configurations; underlying Service can support up to 256.
Global occurrence uniqueness is an upstream full-source validation precondition, not certified by this fixed-space planner.
Exhaustive tests are bounded by the stated alphabet and lengths; they are not proof of arbitrary native histories.
No native gate, thread, audio callback, wire extension, runtime policy or decoder is introduced.
No native record or fresh replay is run; original long CrossedScan remains unresolved by the production code.
Stage 2 remains incomplete and stage 3 is not started.
result_policy: Preserve the first terminal result, including compilation/test failure or timeout. No timing rerolls.
Publish only sanitized counts, identities and necessary failure details, not raw logs, local paths, binary artifacts or tape.
Any correction requires a new frozen source and plan before another execution.
